BiblicalUsage: Harsha is named twice, among the children of the Nethinim who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. His children are counted in both return lists, Ezra's and Nehemiah's.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe exile did not erase the servants: Harsha's children are counted among those who came back to rebuild.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
